meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: 首次被调用且没有具体问题时,Claude 只回复一段固定介绍语;之后它会以 Emil Kowalski 的界面设计理念回答动画取舍、时长与缓动等设计问题,并在审查 UI 代码时用「Before/After/Why」表格输出。
howto.when: 当用户要求审查界面代码、设计动画或询问设计工程建议时触发;首次无具体问题调用时只显示欢迎语。

say.text: 帮我审查这段按钮的 :hover 和 :active 动画。
say.note: Claude 会按四个步骤分析并输出对照表。

say.text: 这个弹出菜单该用哪种缓动曲线和时长?
say.note: 它会按动画决策框架给出具体数值。

say.text: 把这段 CSS 动画改成可中断的过渡。

howto.what_en: When first invoked without a specific question, Claude replies with a fixed intro line. Afterwards it answers UI design questions using Emil Kowalski's philosophy—deciding whether/how to animate, choosing durations and easings—and presents UI code reviews as a Before/After/Why table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about UI polish, component design, or animation decisions; when reviewing code, Claude applies the framework and outputs a comparison table.

say_en.note: Claude analyzes via four steps and outputs a table.

say_en.text: Which easing curve and duration should this popover use?
say_en.note: It will give concrete values via the framework.

say_en.text: Turn this CSS animation into an interruptible transition.
say_en.note: It replaces keyframes with transition and explains why.
